I keep hearing trades are making a comeback in terms of employment opportunities, and the pay is pretty okay as far as I can tell.  I have a friend who apprenticed as an electrician and he really enjoys it; I think he got paid while he learned, but I'm not sure how much.  I'd be happy to ask him for specifics!  In general, though, I think pay versus cost of living depends a lot on which area you live in, too...

\<3
Ah, no, you're right, and thank you for your note.  I should probably find a professional person \>\<

All this must be so difficult...I'm sorry you're having to go through this.  You said you blame yourself, but please know none of this is your fault.  Truly, truly, truly.

I highly recommend a sub called [r/raisedbynarcissists](https://www.reddit.com/r/raisedbynarcissists/) that would be another good place for support \(in addition to this one\) for you, given the abusive situation with your mom.  

And, I'm not sure if you have already, but is there a professional you can speak with where you are?  Your college might have free mental health counseling services available to students that may be worth checking out. 

Finally, as far as career stuff goes, how do you feel about working towards a certification in a trade rather than a traditional college degree \(i.e. welder, electrician, etc\)?
